sections.title: Pennsylvania real estate transfer tax

rows.label: State realty transfer tax rate
rows.note: 1% of the value of real estate transferred by deed, instrument, long-term lease or other writing; 15% of collections go to the Keystone Recreation, Park and Conservation Fund.

source.title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Seller (grantor) and buyer (grantee) are jointly and severally liable
rows.note: In practice the split is set in the sale contract.

source.title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax

rows.label: Local realty transfer tax
rows.value: Usually 1% (more in some localities), often shared between the municipality and school district
rows.note: Collected with the state tax by the county Recorder of Deeds.

source.title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue: Realty Transfer Tax, New Home Construction

rows.label: Main exemptions
rows.value: Certain transfers among family members, to government units, between religious organizations, to shareholders or partners, inheritances, burial sites and certain farm transfers
rows.note: Abbreviated list from the Department of Revenue; full rules are in the realty transfer tax law.
